title: Integral inverse cancellation agrees with the ordinary-image normalization
statement: Fix a prime ell and a finite extension E of Q_ell [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let C be an IntegralComparisonSystem [def-sf-integral-comparison-system-data], g:X -> Y an isomorphism of schemes with ell invertible in every residue field [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and K an integral constructible derived-complete object on Y [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]. The homomorphism obtained by the inverse of the specified completed compositor for (g inverse,g), transport along g inverse followed by g = identity, and the specified completed identity unit equals pullbackIdentityEpsilon(g,K), the inverse-image counit transported through the actual ordinary-to-completed comparisons [lem-pod-pullback-identities-scalar-extension]. This is equality of the actual integral derived morphisms, not only of their finite reductions. The Lean statement uses HEq to preserve the two standard presentations of this same ambient category, and explicitly pins the compositor/unit composite to the full constructible inclusion presentation.

source.place: Weil-structures paragraph: canonical inverse-composition comparisons; parent detailed proof steps 4--6, using the normalized whole-system realization.

proof.text: Choose a flat-term K-flat representative of K and its simultaneous quotient diagram. Reindex it by g and its inverse. The inverse-image equivalence and the actual coefficient maps identify their composite with the original whole diagram: sections, coefficient actions, augmentations and transitions agree. The sequence compositor followed by its identity unit is therefore the ordinary inverse-image counit on this system.

Apply total limit. The representative normalizations of the pullback realization models identify the counit-built integral compositor and completeness unit with that system calculation. Use the whole-system substitution comparison; equality is not inferred merely from all individual finite reductions.

For g and its inverse substitute theta kappa = H(unit), the normalization of the actual ordinary-to-completed comparison. Naturality and the reduction/limit adjunction triangle cancel the intermediate reconstruction units and counits. The remaining composite is lambda for the inverse, inverse image of lambda for g, and the ordinary inverse-image counit. This is exactly pullbackIdentityEpsilon. Resolving localization and naturality carry the equality from the representative to K.

lean.statement:
theorem integralAutomorphismCancellation_normalization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (C : IntegralComparisonSystem.{u} l) {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g] (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y) :
    HEq (pullbackIdentityEpsilon l E g K).hom
      (((integralComparisonComposition l E C (inv g) g K).symm ≪≫
        eqToIso (congrArg (fun f ↦ (integralDerivedPullback l E f).obj K.obj)
          (IsIso.inv_hom_id g)) ≪≫ integralComparisonUnit l E C Y K :
        ((constructibleIntegralPullback l E g ⋙
          constructibleIntegralPullback l E (inv g)).obj K).obj ≅ K.obj).hom)
